incident_text: A large smoke column over the fields, probably a grass fire. Nobody is nearby.

result.scene_summary: A large plume of smoke rises from a field, with a fence and some dark figures in the foreground, under a hazy sky.

observations.description: A large, dense, orange-tinged smoke column rising from the field, visible against the sky.
A wire fence with posts is visible in the mid-ground.
No discernible human figures are visible in the field or near the smoke.
Dry, golden-brown grass covers the field, with some green patches in the foreground.
Several small, dark, indistinct shapes are visible in the distance, possibly animals.

not_determinable: scale or distance of the fire
structural integrity of any buildings or structures
